faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find answers to common questions about Singapore PR and Citizenship
faq.stillHaveQuestionsDesc: Our team is here to help. Get in touch with us for personalized assistance.

questions.prEligibility: What are the eligibility criteria for Singapore PR?
questions.prEligibilityAnswer: Eligibility depends on factors including age, education, salary, work experience in Singapore, family ties, and integration into society. Generally, applicants should have worked in Singapore for at least 6 months, have good qualifications, and demonstrate commitment to contributing to Singapore.
questions.prProcessingTime: How long does the PR application process take?
questions.prProcessingTimeAnswer: The processing time typically ranges from 4 to 6 months, though it can vary depending on the complexity of your case and the volume of applications being processed.
questions.prDocuments: What documents are required for PR application?
questions.prDocumentsAnswer: Required documents include passport, employment pass, educational certificates, salary statements, tax assessments, birth certificate, marriage certificate (if applicable), and other supporting documents. Our team will provide a complete checklist tailored to your situation.
questions.prWorkPermit: Can I apply for PR while on a work permit?
questions.prWorkPermitAnswer: Yes, you can apply for PR while on a work permit, though having an Employment Pass (EP) or S Pass generally improves your chances. You should have worked in Singapore for at least 6 months before applying.
questions.prSuccessRate: What is the success rate for PR applications?
questions.prSuccessRateAnswer: Our success rate is 95%, which is significantly higher than the industry average. This is achieved through thorough preparation, proper documentation, and expert guidance throughout the process.
questions.citizenshipPRPeriod: How long do I need to be a PR before applying for citizenship?
questions.citizenshipPRPeriodAnswer: While there's no fixed minimum period, most successful applicants have been PRs for at least 2-6 years. The longer you've been a PR and the better integrated you are, the higher your chances.
questions.citizenshipRequirements: What are the requirements for Singapore Citizenship?
questions.citizenshipRequirementsAnswer: Requirements include being at least 21 years old, being a PR for a sufficient period, having good character, demonstrating integration into Singapore society, and showing commitment to contributing to Singapore's development.
questions.citizenshipDual: Do I need to renounce my current citizenship?
questions.citizenshipDualAnswer: Singapore generally does not allow dual citizenship for adults. You will need to renounce your current citizenship upon approval of Singapore citizenship, though there are some exceptions for certain countries.
questions.citizenshipInterview: What is the citizenship interview like?
questions.citizenshipInterviewAnswer: The interview assesses your integration into Singapore society, understanding of local culture, and commitment to Singapore. It typically includes questions about your life in Singapore, community involvement, and reasons for wanting citizenship.
questions.citizenshipProcessingTime: How long does citizenship application take?
questions.citizenshipProcessingTimeAnswer: The processing time is typically 6 to 12 months, though it can vary. The process includes document review, interview, and final approval stages.
questions.generalServicesAnswer: We provide comprehensive immigration consultancy services including PR application assistance, citizenship application guidance, consultation services, document preparation, eligibility assessments, and ongoing support throughout the application process.
questions.generalCost: How much do your services cost?
questions.generalCostAnswer: Our service fees vary depending on the type of application and complexity of your case. PR application assistance starts from $2,500, citizenship applications from $3,500, and consultations from $200/hour. Contact us for a personalized quote.
questions.generalGuaranteeAnswer: While we cannot guarantee approval as final decisions are made by the authorities, our 95% success rate demonstrates our expertise. We ensure your application is prepared to the highest standards to maximize your chances of success.
questions.generalDifferenceAnswer: We combine 15+ years of experience, a 95% success rate, personalized service, and deep expertise in Singapore immigration law. Every client receives dedicated attention and tailored guidance throughout their journey.
questions.generalGetStartedAnswer: You can start by taking our free eligibility assessment, scheduling a consultation, or contacting us directly. We'll assess your situation and provide guidance on the best path forward for your immigration goals.
